injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: —Initiation, sequencing, and closing require significant involvement of external structures.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: When missions lack immediate feedback, your follow-through system can easily slow down.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your load comes not from not knowing the goal, but from continually keeping the goal in the foreground.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: This shows that your execution stability is significantly lower than the middle of the reference sample, and you need the environment to help you take over the rhythm.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: Make one thing a priority: narrow down today’s next step to one that can be started in ten minutes.

injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: ——You can do things, but continued advancement depends more on status, meaning and external beats.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: It’s not that you can’t be responsible, but low feedback and long-term tasks will consume endurance faster.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your operational load comes primarily from long-term maintenance of order, not short-term bursts.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: This is closer to low endurance follow-through: it can be started, but the system needs to help you keep renewing it.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: For you, the key to regaining momentum is an external checklist, a fixed cadence, and shorter completion cycles.

injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: ——You have basic execution ability, but it will be clearly affected by the quality of the task.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: When your goals are clear and feedback is timely, your progress will be more stable.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your system is not designed to push all tasks into the same priority.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: You are in the middle of the reference sample, more like a situational performer than a low performer or a high control type.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: The next step is to establish fixed entrances to key tasks to reduce on-the-fly decisions.

injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: ——It’s easier for you to turn your commitments into plans and keep tracking them to completion.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: As long as your goals are reasonable, you can usually use structure and accountability to get things done.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your load may come from overcommitment rather than a lack of execution.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: You are already significantly higher in the reference sample, and execution stability is an advantage you can rely on.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: The next step for you is not to work harder, but to distinguish which tasks deserve high standards.

injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: ——You will strongly pursue order, standards and a sense of completion.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: Unfinished work, low standards, and out-of-control progress will occupy your attention more than most.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your system is very good at advancing, and it is easy to experience adjustable items as must be completed.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: This is a high conscientiousness position, where a sense of responsibility and control can easily become your default drive.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: The most important thing at this time is to grade the tasks and allow some things to be only good enough.
